function: Over-the-air aggregation of local FL models with digital QAM; an MLP predicts local updates so joint transmit and receive beamformers can be set (p. 2, 5).
system: MIMO uplink: K=20 devices with Nt=2 antennas each, PS with Nr=2; 64-QAM, 64 subcarriers of 15 kHz; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, 8).
method: Three-layer MLP (one hidden layer, D neurons) trained online by gradient descent alongside FedAvg to predict local updates; beamformers by closed form and augmented Lagrangian (p. 5-7).
data_channel: Simulated i.i.d. Rayleigh fading (path-loss exponent 2), also Rician (k=7, 10); Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 for the FL tasks; no standardized or measured channel (p. 8, 10).
test_conditions: Online MLP and FL training per setting, tested in the same run; sweeps of IID/non-IID data, Rayleigh/Rician, noise, SNR, devices, Nr, each run separately (p. 6, 10-12).
baselines: Analog AirComp FL [27], BPSK AirComp FL [36], ChannelComp [41], proposed method without MLP, and a noiseless-channel upper bound (p. 8).
metrics: FL test accuracy, rounds to convergence, per-round and total latency, MLP prediction MSE, aggregated-model error CDF (p. 8-11).
complexity: MLP training O(2V'D); augmented-Lagrangian beamforming O(L_O K^2); latency per round 1.26 s versus 1.03 s for analog FL on Fashion-MNIST (p. 7, 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "the channels between the PS and devices are modeled as independent and identically distributed with Rayleigh fading". A custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 6: "The MLP is trained through an online gradient descent method in parallel with the FL model updating." p. 10: "We consider the implementation of the proposed framework over four channel conditions". Each condition is its own run; no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 8: "improves the test accuracy by up to 15.5% and 24.5% compared to analog FL and BPSK FL" (earlier designs [27], [36]). p. 9: "an improvement of up to 10% compared to employing ChannelComp [41]" (optimization-based). p. 8: "the proposed method without using MLP for predicting FL gradients cannot converge".
q4_support: p. 7: "the complexity is O(LO K 2 )" for the beamforming optimization, and "the computational complexity is O(2V ′ D)" for the MLP.
q5_support: p. 8: "The Fashion-MNIST dataset [59] and CIFAR-10 dataset [60] are used as ML tasks". These are learning-task datasets and the channel is simulated; the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Included in area 7: digital QAM AirComp aggregation in a multi-antenna uplink (Nr=2, Nt=2), so the single-antenna check does not apply. q3 relies on the federated-learning-over-the-air rule: analog FL [27] and BPSK FL [36] are earlier published aggregation designs, while ChannelComp [41] and the fixed-beamforming variant without MLP are the non-learned comparisons; the reviewer should confirm this reading. q2 is 0 because each channel, SNR, device-count or antenna setting is a separate online training run.
